projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for pipeline focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'pipeline' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'pipeline'
Add stories US-51-002 through US-51-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code

userStories.notes: Generated 11 stories (US-51-002 through US-51-012) covering: stall detection for Python API downloads, iterative_match serialization fix, bot-detection abort logic, DNS/network failure pattern hardening, per-download progress hooks, checkpoint backup rotation, stage restore validation, pipeline dry-run mode, download retry queue persistence, stage-level error aggregation, and pipeline stage timing histograms.

userStories.title: Add stall detection wrapper around yt-dlp Python API downloads
acceptanceCriteria: ydl.download() call in download_segments.py is wrapped in a concurrent.futures timeout (configurable, default 300s)
When timeout fires, the download is cancelled and a DownloadStallError (or equivalent) is raised
The raised error feeds into existing retry/escalation logic so the video is queued for retry at next tier
socket_timeout in ydl_opts remains unchanged (it covers HTTP sockets only, not ffmpeg stalls)
Unit test verifies timeout fires when ydl.download() blocks beyond threshold
Unit test verifies escalation is triggered after stall timeout
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented by US-49-004. Verified all 6 acceptance criteria met: (1) ydl.download() wrapped in ThreadPoolExecutor at download_segments.py:720-740, configurable via segment_stall_timeout (default 120s) in download.py:1192 and config.yaml:1347. (2) TimeoutError raised on stall at line 737. (3) Error feeds into retry via except Exception at line 776, classified as 'timeout' by classify_error_category, added to retry queue. (4) socket_timeout unchanged â€” separate config. (5) test_stall_timeout_triggers_on_hung_download passes. (6) test_stall_timeout_increments_failure_and_feeds_retry_queue and test_stall_timeout_error_does_not_trigger_bot_escalation both pass. All 6 tests in TestSegmentStallTimeout pass.

userStories.title: Fix iterative_match else-branch match serialization for plain Match objects
acceptanceCriteria: The else branch in iterative_match.py match serialization (around line 450-461) correctly extracts video_file from Match objects that have a video_file attribute
For MatchResult objects that fall into the else branch (lacking primary_match), video_file extraction uses safe navigation through available attributes
Serialized matches with empty video_file are logged as warnings so the issue is visible
Unit test with a mock Match object (has video_file) serializes correctly via the else branch
Unit test with a mock MatchResult (no primary_match, no video_file) serializes with empty string and logs warning
userStories.notes: Fixed: else-branch now extracts video_file via getattr for plain Match objects, and logs warning with type name when video_file is empty (for MatchResult with primary_match=None). Added 4 tests in TestElseBranchMatchSerialization. Updated _serialize_match test helper to mirror production code.

userStories.title: Add consecutive bot-detection counter with global tier floor
acceptanceCriteria: A shared consecutive bot-detection counter tracks 403/Sign-in errors across all video IDs in the download loop
When bot-detection counter exceeds a configurable threshold (default 5), a global tier floor is set so new downloads start at the highest available tier instead of Tier 1
Bot-detection errors no longer reset the network failure abort counter (the counter reset at lines ~858-860 is removed or gated)
When bot-detection counter exceeds a higher threshold (default 10), the download loop aborts early with a clear error message
Unit test verifies global tier floor activates after threshold consecutive bot-detection errors
Unit test verifies download loop aborts after abort-threshold bot-detection errors
userStories.notes: Pre-implemented by US-49-005 (tier floor) and US-49-008 (abort threshold). All 6 acceptance criteria met by existing code: consecutive_bot_detections counter at download_segments.py:525, tier floor at lines 797-808, abort at lines 811-842, network counter isolation at lines 846-871. Config: download.bot_detection_tier_floor_threshold (default 5) and download.bot_detection_abort_threshold (default 10) in src/config/sections/download.py and config.yaml. Tests: test_bot_detection_global_counter.py (5 tests) and test_download_segments_bot_abort.py (7 tests). Fixed stale file bug in test_success_resets_counter_and_clears_tier_floor (used tempfile instead of hardcoded /tmp path).

userStories.title: Harden _is_network_failure pattern matching for Python API error format
userStories.notes: Tier: P2 bug fix. Source: src/stages/download_segments.py lines 31-73. The _NETWORK_FAILURE_PATTERNS tuple and _is_network_failure() function. Current patterns include 'Errno 11001' and 'getaddrinfo failed' but the Python API wraps these in 'ERROR: unable to download webpage: <urlopen error ...>' format which may not match simple substring checks. The _FFMPEG_NETWORK_EXIT_CODE constant handles the ffmpeg exit code. Verify the patterns also work with yt_dlp.utils.DownloadError exception message format. Add 'Connection refused' and 'Connection timed out' patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: _is_network_failure() at download_segments.py recognizes Python API DownloadError wrapping of DNS failures (e.g., 'ERROR: unable to download webpage: <urlopen error [Errno 11001]>')
_is_network_failure() recognizes ffmpeg exit code 4294967158 (0xFFFFFEC6 = -314 signed) as a network failure
_is_network_failure() recognizes 'Connection refused' and 'Connection timed out' patterns
Unit test covers all new patterns with exact error strings from production logs
Unit test verifies bot-detection patterns ('Sign in to confirm', '403 Forbidden') are NOT classified as network failures

userStories.title: Add per-download progress hooks for segment download observability
acceptanceCriteria: ydl_opts includes a 'progress_hooks' callback that logs download progress at INFO level for segments taking >30s
Progress hook logs bytes downloaded, estimated total, and download speed when status is 'downloading' and elapsed >30s
Progress hook logs final file size and total time when status is 'finished'
Progress data is accumulated into stage metrics (the StageMetrics dict saved to checkpoint)
Unit test verifies progress hook callback is invoked with expected status values
Progress hook does not log for fast downloads (<30s) to avoid log spam
userStories.notes: Implemented: Added _make_progress_hook() static method to DownloadVideoSegmentsStage (download_segments.py:925-978). Hook is injected into ydl_opts at line 669. Logs INFO for slow downloads (>30s) with bytes/total/speed, throttled every 15s. Logs finished status with file size and elapsed time. Accumulates progress_hooks_data into stats dict, which flows into StageMetrics via escalation_summary (lines 392-395). 20 tests in test_segment_progress_hook.py cover creation, status values, slow/fast logging, finished logging, metrics accumulation, and edge cases.

userStories.title: Add checkpoint backup rotation to prevent corruption data loss
acceptanceCriteria: Checkpoint save (in checkpoint.py _atomic_save) rotates up to N backup files (default 3): checkpoint.backup.json, checkpoint.backup.1.json, checkpoint.backup.2.json
Each save rotates existing backups (2->3 deleted, 1->2, current->1, new backup created)
Backup rotation count is configurable via infrastructure config section
When checkpoint.json is corrupted (fails JSON parse), restore automatically tries backup files in order
Unit test verifies backup rotation creates correct number of files
Unit test verifies restore from backup when primary checkpoint is corrupted
userStories.notes: Implemented in checkpoint.py: _rotate_backups() rotates N backup files before each save, _get_backup_path()/get_all_backup_paths() manage paths. load() tries rotated backups (backup.1, backup.2...) when main+primary backup are both corrupt. clear() removes all rotated backups. Config: pipeline.checkpoint_backup_count (default 3) in PipelineConfig. 17 tests in test_checkpoint_backup_rotation.py, all 209 existing checkpoint tests pass.

userStories.title: Add stage restore validation with mismatch warnings
acceptanceCriteria: Each stage's restore() method validates that checkpoint data matches expected schema/keys before restoring
When checkpoint data has missing required keys, restore() logs a WARNING with the missing keys and returns False
When checkpoint data has unexpected type mismatches (e.g., string where list expected), restore() logs WARNING and returns False
Pipeline orchestrator handles restore() returning False by re-running the stage instead of proceeding with bad state
Unit test verifies restore() returns False and logs warning when given checkpoint data with missing keys
Unit test verifies pipeline re-runs stage when restore returns False
userStories.notes: Implemented: Added schema/key validation to restore() in ANALYZE, VIDEO_SEARCH, CAPTION, MATCH, ITERATIVE_MATCH stages. Pipeline.py now re-runs stage instead of continuing when restore() returns False. 22 new tests in test_stage_restore_validation.py. All 380 related tests pass.

userStories.title: Add pipeline dry-run mode for stage validation without execution
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline.run(dry_run=True) validates all stage inputs in sequence without executing any stage
Dry-run reports which stages would run, which would skip (checkpoint), and which have input validation errors
Dry-run output is logged at INFO level with a summary table of stage -> action (run/skip/error)
The --dry-run CLI flag is wired through cli/ to pipeline.run(dry_run=True)
Unit test verifies dry-run does not modify state or checkpoint
Unit test verifies dry-run correctly identifies stages that would fail validation
userStories.notes: Enhanced _run_dry_run in src/pipeline.py to: load checkpoint for skip detection, categorize stages as run/checkpoint/skip/error, validate inputs for runnable stages, produce structured summary table. Wired --dry-run CLI flag through main.py. 16 new tests in tests/test_pipeline_dry_run.py covering no-execution, no-state-modification, stage categorization, return values, summary logging, and CLI flag parsing.

userStories.title: Add download retry queue persistence across pipeline restarts
acceptanceCriteria: Videos that fail all escalation tiers in DOWNLOAD_SEGMENTS are saved to a retry_queue list in checkpoint data
On pipeline resume, the retry queue is loaded and those videos are retried before processing new segments
Retry queue entries include video_id, last_tier_attempted, failure_reason, and timestamp
Retry queue has a configurable max_retries_per_video (default 3) â€” videos exceeding this are permanently skipped
Unit test verifies retry queue is persisted to checkpoint on stage completion
Unit test verifies retry queue is loaded and processed on resume
userStories.notes: US-51-010: Retry queue now persisted to checkpoint.json under download_segments.retry_queue. On resume, previously-failed videos are loaded and retried before processing new segments. Videos exceeding max_retries_per_video (default 3) are permanently skipped. Entries include video_id, last_tier_attempted, failure_reason, timestamp. Config: batch_retry.max_retries_per_video in config.yaml and BatchRetryConfig. 81 new+existing tests pass.

userStories.title: Add stage-level error aggregation with categorized failure summary
acceptanceCriteria: Each pipeline stage collects errors into categorized buckets (network, auth, timeout, validation, unknown) during execution
Stage completion summary logs a table of error_category -> count -> sample_message
Error categories are defined in a shared enum/constants module usable across all stages
DOWNLOAD_SEGMENTS stage uses error categories to classify bot-detection, network, and timeout failures
Unit test verifies error aggregation collects and categorizes errors correctly
Unit test verifies completion summary includes all error categories with counts
userStories.notes: Tier: P3 improvement. Source: src/stages/download_segments.py â€” errors are currently logged individually but not aggregated. The stage completion log (around line 870+) shows counts but not categorized breakdowns. Add an ErrorAggregator class (could live in src/stages/base.py or src/stages/utils.py) that stages can use. Error categories should align with existing _is_network_failure() and _is_bot_detection() patterns. This builds on the StageMetrics infrastructure from US-49-012.

userStories.title: Add pipeline stage timing histograms to completion summary
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline completion summary includes per-stage duration (wall-clock seconds) in a formatted table
Stage timing data is persisted to checkpoint under stage_metrics for post-run analysis
Total pipeline duration and per-stage percentage of total are included in the summary
Stages that were skipped (checkpoint resume) show 'skipped' instead of 0s duration
Unit test verifies timing data is collected and formatted correctly
Unit test verifies skipped stages are marked as 'skipped' in the summary
userStories.notes: Tier: P3 improvement. Source: src/pipeline.py lines 342-463 (run loop) â€” stage timing is partially implemented via StageMetrics (US-49-012) but there is no end-of-pipeline summary that aggregates all stage timings into a readable table. The stage_metrics dict in CheckpointData (checkpoint.py:96) stores per-stage metrics. Add a _print_timing_summary() method to PipelineOrchestrator that reads from self.stage_metrics after the run loop completes. Format as: Stage | Duration | % of Total.
